# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py. Do not edit by hand; run the script. -->

## `bidwright`

```text
usage: bidwright [-h] {run,demo,record} ...

Bidwright: RFP to proposal.

positional arguments:
  {run,demo,record}
    run              run one RFP live
    demo             replay the recorded development run, with no keys
    record           run live and record cassettes, on the host

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
```

## `bidwright run`

```text
usage: bidwright run [-h] [--profile {free,local}] [--baseline {b0,ex0}]
                     [--allow-non-corpus CONSENT] [--outputs OUTPUTS]
                     file

positional arguments:
  file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --profile {free,local}
  --baseline {b0,ex0}
  --allow-non-corpus CONSENT
  --outputs OUTPUTS
```

## `bidwright demo`

```text
usage: bidwright demo [-h] [--outputs OUTPUTS]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --outputs OUTPUTS
```

## `bidwright record`

```text
usage: bidwright record [-h] [--name NAME] [--profile {free,local}] [--outputs OUTPUTS] file

positional arguments:
  file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME
  --profile {free,local}
  --outputs OUTPUTS
```

## `bidwright-eval`

```text
usage: bidwright-eval [-h] {score,hash-gold} ...

`bidwright-eval`: score frozen runs against gold. It never changes a run. bidwright-eval score
<run_dir> prints the 0a scorecard and writes evals/results/runs/<run>/ bidwright-eval hash-gold
records the hashes of the gold files and of evals/hypotheses.yaml in evals/gold/MANIFEST.sha256

positional arguments:
  {score,hash-gold}
    score            score one run folder
    hash-gold        freeze the current gold files' hashes

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
```

## `bidwright-eval score`

```text
usage: bidwright-eval score [-h] run_dir

positional arguments:
  run_dir

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## `bidwright-eval hash-gold`

```text
usage: bidwright-eval hash-gold [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```
